weakest_frame: Cut from s5-shot-1 to s5-shot-2 at 25.025 s. The same plains layout pushes in 8 percent, the windmill vanishes, and the truck, fire station, landed alert and badge appear in place.
strongest_frame: s3-shot-1 plume-flag, 10.5-13.775 s. The beam crosses the land onto the fire base and the flag box closes on the smoke.
notes: All seven round-one A blockers D1 to D7 are verified fixed in code. One new continuity defect R1 comes from the open-line rework. Non-blocking: watch dial wider than the forearm, truck geography flips sides, the fast 1.14 s opening revolution needs a phone check.
blocking_defects: R1 continuity, 25.025 s cut. plume-hold and open-line render the same plains layout at nearly the same framing; the windmill disappears and the truck, station, landed alert and badge appear with no motivation.

story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from code, not observed. A lattice tower's camera spins once and leaves a watch ring. 16 of 56 slots light. At the tower's foot the beam finds a plume and a flag locks. An alert card leaves the head, runs down the coax toward a distant truck and lands as a bubble on a gloved crew phone. A watch shows a hatched window up to ten minutes marked estimated. The beam holds on the still-burning plume. From the truck a dashed line stops short of a fire-station badge. A wall calendar since launch has no red mark. A blank record on the truck's tailgate stays empty. The filed plan waits on state approval above the still-sweeping tower, the landed alert and the open line.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on the camera watching all the way around, answers by about 17 s that a text reaches the utility's crew, then gives the limits and closes on a composite that shows the answer under the pending plan.
story_review.weakest_transition: s5-shot-1 to s5-shot-2 (R1): the same world with the windmill swapped for a station and truck.
